# Maddyness

> > Maddyness is the leading French media platform for understanding tomorrow's economy through startup news, AI coverage, and venture capital insights.

Maddyness provides comprehensive coverage of the French and European tech ecosystem, with specialized platforms for AI, venture funding tracking, and entrepreneurship education. The site serves as a central hub for startup news, investor intelligence, and innovation trends across multiple sectors.

## Key Topics

- French startups
- Venture capital
- Startup funding
- Artificial intelligence
- Entrepreneurship
- Tech news
- AI regulation
- Mistral AI
- Europe tech ecosystem
- Fintech
- Impact investing
- Cryptocurrency
- Startup ecosystem
- Business intelligence
- Innovation

## Core Platforms

- [Maddyness Homepage](https://www.maddyness.com): Main hub for French tech news, startup funding, and AI regulation coverage
- [Maddyness IA](https://ia.maddyness.com): Dedicated AI platform covering generative AI, NotebookLM, and French AI startups
- [Maddyplay](https://www.maddyness.com/maddyplay): Video platform featuring startup stories, entrepreneur interviews, and innovation content

## Funding & Investment Intelligence

- [Fundraising Tracking](https://www.maddyness.com/levees-de-fonds): Comprehensive fundraising analytics and funding tracking for tech startups
- [MDVC Investor Database](https://www.maddyness.com/base-fonds-investissements): Investor database covering VC funds, private equity firms, and incubators
- [MaddyMoney](https://www.maddyness.com/hashtag/maddymoney): Weekly funding recap highlighting French startup fundraising and AI investment trends

## Industry Sectors & News

- [Sectors Directory](https://www.maddyness.com/secteurs): Comprehensive industry sector directory for startup news and business intelligence
- [Fintech News](https://www.maddyness.com/secteur/fintech): Fintech sector coverage including startup news and industry developments
- [Impact Investing](https://www.maddyness.com/secteur/impact): Impact investing and sustainable business sector news
- [Retail Sector](https://www.maddyness.com/secteur/retail): Retail industry business news and sector updates
- [UK Startup Ecosystem](https://www.maddyness.com/uk): UK startup ecosystem news covering Mistral AI, Pigment, and tech expansion

## Events & Community

- [Event Calendar](https://www.maddyness.com/agenda): Comprehensive event calendar for French startup conferences, hackathons, and innovation summits

## Entrepreneurship Resources

- [Backpack Entrepreneurship Guide](https://www.maddyness.com/produit/backpack-guide-entrepreneuriat): Complete entrepreneurship guide covering startup fundamentals, growth strategies, and best practices
- [Resource Library](https://www.maddyness.com/bibliotheque): Curated library of books, guides, and whitepapers on innovation and entrepreneurship

## Optional

- [Newsletters Archive](https://www.maddyness.com/newsletters): Archive of weekly AI and innovation newsletters
- [User Account](https://www.maddyness.com/mon-compte): User account management page for Maddyness platform
